s2:Sun global Alfvén resonance from decade-scale dynamics of N–S separated fast sol

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the long-term magnetic behavior of objects near the cooler end of the stellar main sequence. They focus on related topics such as brown dwarf magnetism, flares, and radio emissions, but do not provide evidence directly addressing the question.
